name: smwgraphics-super-princess-peach-geyser
title: Super Princess Peach - Geyser
description:
This sprite comes from World 5, Wavy Beach, this can act as a platform, but be careful, when using this sprite, it is recommended to edit the BG2 destination animations, as the 2 middle tiles are used to hold the player.

Rykon-V73 Edit: The sprite uses less of it's original frames for easier optimization, as it was somewhat tile heavy.
